verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework installed locally via `cargo install proa-cli`. Its scaffolded apps run their own Axum server (localhost:3000 in dev) and can be deployed to production behind your own proxy, with source published on GitHub. The core product therefore runs entirely on user-controlled infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, a documented production self-hosting/deployment guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.
